rationale: Price is at 98.8% of today's range, just $0.11 below the session high of $159.42, with extremely compressed 1-minute candles showing minimal range and declining volume — the stock is stalling at the top with no clear breakout momentum. A long here risks immediate reversal from the high with only 31 minutes to close and a bearish broader market (SPY -0.48%, VIXY +1.98%), while a short against a strong uptrend (up ~5% today on 2.89x relative volume) with price above VWAP by $2.74 and above the 9-EMA offers poor risk/reward.
